milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find a horse' means the player has navigated close enough to the horse paddock and is facing toward it, confirming visual identification. The horses are summoned at spawn-relative [14, 1, 14] and [14, 1, 15] inside a fence corral. Target is set to the center of the paddock [14, 1, 14]. max_distance=16 allows the player to 'find' the horse from a reasonable viewing distance (within render range and clearly visible). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the horse, not just passing nearby while facing away.
